key_insight: Rejecting suspect literature-mined values using physics-aware checks can protect materials AI from errors that distort discovery rankings.
engineering_relevance: Materials-data pipelines should validate provenance, physical consistency, and cross-source agreement before extracted values enter predictive models.
method: Classify extraction errors by origin and observable signatures.
Layer schema and provenance checks with physical bounds, symmetry rules, and governing equations.
Combine cross-source consensus and model auditing to prioritize suspicious records for review.
evidence_signal: In a controlled benchmark, the combined framework detected 81% of errors at 85% precision and brought held-out model accuracy within 3% of a model trained on clean data.
watch_item: Validation remains imperfect: 30 of 112 accepted values were defective in a curated-reference audit, and missing measurement conditions limit record comparability.
paper_title: No Value Is Better Than a Wrong Value: Finding and Handling Erroneous Data in Literature-Mined Datasets for AI
